'''Docking Bay B-04''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] in the [[Dromund Kaas spaceport]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], it was once used by a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] to dock his [[Hunter's D5-Mantis Patrol Craft|D5-''Mantis'' Patrol Craft]]. Despite [[Tarro Blood]]'s warning of the docking bay staff, a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] killed the [[Security officer/Legends|security officers]] and the smuggler and stole the ship as part of a tradition in the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]], taking ownership of the ship.<ref name="TOR" />
